criteria.requirement: Add textdistance.weighted.WeightedLevenshtein with finite nonnegative insertion/deletion/substitution constants or token callbacks, qval and test_func using actual pinned preparation. Compute exact minimum path costs from source to target; insertion/deletion may be asymmetric, substitution may be more expensive than delete+insert, zero costs and fractional costs are legitimate. Validate bad constants at configuration and bad callback results when used; bool/negative/NaN/Inf reject. Equal units cost zero according to the predicate. Expose call/distance without claiming every asymmetric policy is a mathematical metric or inventing a normalized bound. Original Levenshtein and optional backend behavior stay unchanged.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
